# Moogy Namkeen

> Moogy Namkeen is a chips and namkeen brand from Bihar, India, making crunchy, fresh and 100% vegetarian snacks for kids, families, retailers and distributors across Bihar and Jharkhand.

Every Moogy product is 100% vegetarian, prepared in a hygienic facility and packed fresh, with manufacturing and expiry dates printed on the pack. The brand sells to customers directly and offers wholesale, retail and distributor opportunities.

## Main Page

- [Moogy Namkeen – Home](https://moogynamkeen.in/): Brand overview, product range, quality promise, customer reviews, wholesale/distributor information, FAQs and contact form

## Products

- Chips, Rings, Cheese Balls, Jumping Balls, Kur Karare, Tapatap Kurmure
- Bikanery Bhujiya, Nimbu Bhujia, Dalmoth, Diet Chiwda, Hara Matar, Badam Pakoda, Masala Kaju
- Chatpata snacks: Chaat Chokdi, Chatori, Kasturi Chatpata, Punjabi Tadka, Sab Kuch, Chokis, Chiku
- Flavoured snacks: Masala Idli, Noodles, Pasta, Palak Paneer, Veg Biryani, Manchurian Bharpet, Momo, LiliPut, Light Box, Refill
- Candy and Candy Toy for kids

## Wholesale & Distribution

- [Distributor & wholesale enquiries](https://moogynamkeen.in/#contact): Retailers, wholesalers and distributors in Bihar and Jharkhand can contact Moogy for wholesale rates and distributorship
